title: Koquetel session handle (SCH-21)
description: Realizes the ADR-0010 v1 session lifecycle + identifier contract (RF-04). Root validates a SessionHandle. sessionId is a 128-bit CSPRNG correlation identifier (32 lowercase hex), NOT a bearer credential — authority is revalidated per request and never derived from it.

schemaVersion.description: strict-write: v1 pins the major; unknown major fails closed (SC-09).

sessionId.description: 128 bits from a CSPRNG, canonical wire form 32 lowercase hex. Correlation identifier, not a credential; immutable once created; authority is never derived from it.

expiresAt.description: MUST be later than createdAt (semantic invariant, checked by SC-11).

actorRef.description: reference to the authenticated actor; authority is checked per request, never taken from this handle.

checkpointRef.description: optional reference to an SCH-16 TaskCheckpoint.

endedAt.description: required when state = ended (conditional invariant below).
